description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds; 0.17.8: giving the space back is re-asserted on every layout pass from the bar's own tree — the live pager is found from the bar and its bottom padding, and its pages', is taken again whenever Facebook settles it back — and the Reels page's own header hides too, on its own switch in Appearance, its height collapsed so reels get that space, back for three seconds on a touch) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open, EXTENDED in 0.17.8 (the Hook diagnostics row proved the in-place controller path is never reached on the test phone — zero calls while real comments opened — so the half cap now also stands on the surfaces that phone can take: the regular comment sheet, its share capped where its parameters are built and its window height capped at both places the popover fragment settles it, the fixed eight-tenths box a full share falls back to included; and the video platform's split screen, its sheet height capped where it is handed to the sheet's component. The five split-screen launchers and the comment views setup only report that they ran, so the Hook diagnostics row — itself extended with the hunt's last-seen shares, ratio and heights — can say which surface a phone really opens comments through; on by default, settings > Comments). FITTED in 0.17.9: capping the sheet still left the video full-screen behind it, its lower half hidden under the sheet, so while a comment sheet is open the playing video's container is now settled into exactly the space the sheet leaves — the page's width, from the page's top down to the sheet's top edge — and the player re-fits the whole frame inside it, centred, as large as its aspect allows; closing the sheet gives the container back + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance; 0.17.9: on the Reels tab the bar's fills are fully transparent and the opaque backgrounds of the pager, the Reels page and the bar's frame are cleared, while the reel's video container is lengthened to the bottom of the screen, so a reel runs to the bottom edge under the bar) + the Hook diagnostics row (settings > Pause, backup and diagnostics); quiet preset.
